class_definitions.rules: camelyon17-simplified/1: CAMELYON17's simplified staging rules. Positive nodes P = nodes labelled micro or macro; ITC-only nodes are not positive nodes (the AJCC rule, which CAMELYON17 applies). pN0 = every node negative; pN0(i+) = P = 0 and at least one ITC node; pN1mi = P ≥ 1 and no macro node; pN1 = 1 ≤ P ≤ 3 with at least one macro node; pN2 = 4 ≤ P ≤ 9 with at least one macro node; pN3 is not used. Ordinal order pN0 (0) < pN0(i+) (1) < pN1mi (2) < pN1 (3) < pN2 (4).
class_definitions.node_match: Node class match: the call equals the reference label.
class_definitions.node_minor: Node class minor: negative ↔ itc, or micro ↔ macro (the same side of "a metastasis that counts toward pN").
class_definitions.node_major: Node class major: any pair across {negative, itc} × {micro, macro}: a metastasis present/absent disagreement, where ITC counts as absent.
class_definitions.pn_match: pN class match: the entered pN equals the reference pN.
class_definitions.pn_minor: pN class minor: the entered pN differs from the reference but lies in the same AJCC N category (N0 = pN0, pN0(i+); N1 = pN1mi, pN1; N2 = pN2).
class_definitions.pn_major: pN class major: the entered pN lies in a different AJCC N category from the reference.
class_definitions.case_class: Case class: the worst of the pN class and every node class (major > minor > match).
class_definitions.direction_under: Direction under: the call is below the reference by ordinal order (negative < itc < micro < macro; pN0 < pN0(i+) < pN1mi < pN1 < pN2): a missed node or an under-staged case.
class_definitions.direction_over: Direction over: the call is above the reference by ordinal order: an over-called node or an over-staged case.
class_definitions.borderline: Borderline: the node's reference carries a borderline reason (in the pilot only patient_046 node index 4, a micrometastasis by the > 200-cell criterion that no annotated outline shows) and the call/reference pair is {itc, micro}. The class is computed unchanged (major); the flag is exported so a director can exclude the node.
class_definitions.inconsistent: Inconsistent: the entered pN differs from the pN that the rules give for the trainee's own node calls. A flag, never a class.
class_definitions.complete: Complete: every node was opened and had at least one sharp settled view at ≤ 2 µm/px intersecting its tissue box. An agreement on a node that was not examined is labelled, never counted as a plain match; nodes_not_examined counts them.
class_definitions.miss_type: Miss type (only for an annotated positive node called below its reference: negative or itc for micro or macro, or negative for itc): search = no annotated deposit of the node was ever in a sharp settled view at or finer than the adequate scale (ITC 0.5, micro 1.0, macro 2.0 µm/px); recognition = a deposit was in such a view for ≥ 2 s of cumulative dwell (dwell = time to the next settled view, capped at 30 s) and was not called; indeterminate = in such a view for under 2 s; empty otherwise.
class_definitions.size_category: Size category agreement: the trainee's largest deposit and the reference's longest single annotated outline fall in the same AJCC band (≤ 0.2 mm, > 0.2 to 2.0 mm, > 2.0 mm). Not compared when the trainee gave no size, when no node is annotated, or when the largest deposit may lie in an unannotated node.
class_definitions.size_numeric: Size numeric agreement: the trainee's figure lies within ±20 % of the reference's longest single annotated outline. Secondary to the category; a size never changes a class.
